people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Nahor
people.line: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.

translations.web: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:
translations.bsb: Some time later, Abraham was told, “Milcah has also borne sons to your brother Nahor:
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, Behold, Milcah, she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor;
